scope: Kconfig syntax and raw property parsing only
referenceMethod: One-time Python Kconfig node_iter snapshot of orig_prompt, help, orig_defaults, orig_selects and orig_ranges; source SHA-256 and Kconfig input hashes embedded. Daily test reads frozen JSON without Python.

benchmark.scope: Warm filesystem full-tree parsing including file reads; excludes evaluation, configuration export, menu and process startup. Not a print hot path.

limitations: No default/dependency evaluation, .config/autoconf generation, minimal config export or interactive menu yet
Makefile still invokes Python Kconfiglib; no Python retired by this change
No comparative speedup claim: old constructor also evaluates dependencies
No change to print runtime or motion arithmetic
Historical Node crashes and transient motion mismatches remain unresolved
